Name: Simple Fishdex
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]Simple Fishdex[/b]
Keep a fishing journal right inside Stardew Valley. Check what you can catch nearby, discover new fish and browse your personal collection with two pages: [b]Here Now[/b] and [b]Fishdex[/b].
No purchases, upgrades or research points. Just open the book and start exploring.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]See fish listed for your current location, with availability and fishing requirements.[/*]
[*]Browse your collection with caught/missing, season and location filters.[/*]
[*]View catch counts, largest recorded sizes, fishing difficulty and movement.[/*]
[*]Discover fish naturally, or use Full Guide to reveal their information.[/*]
[*]Supports mouse, keyboard and controller navigation.[/*]
[*]Adapts to different screen sizes, with two columns where space allows.[/*]
[*]Supports all 12 built-in game languages.[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[/list][b]Here Now[/b]
The journal opens on Here Now, showing rod-caught fish listed for your current location.
Check their availability, opening and closing times, and relevant requirements. The guide considers the current season, local weather, fishing level, selected rod and Magic Bait.
Some fish depend on a particular fishing area or where your bobber lands. These requirements are shown as conditional when the journal cannot confirm them.

[b]Fishdex[/b]
Browse the fish collection and filter by season, location or whether you have caught them.
Select a revealed fish to see its catch count, largest recorded size, usual times and weather, difficulty, movement and location 
requirements.

[b]Discovery Mode[/b]
Discovery Mode is enabled by default. Fish you have not caught appear as silhouettes with hidden names.
Catching a fish anywhere reveals it throughout the journal for that farmer. Your discoveries follow your actual catch records.
Prefer to see everything? Full Guide reveals fish information without changing your catches or collection progress.
This journal focuses on rod fishing; crab-pot creatures are not included.

[b]How to use[/b]
Click the small fish-book icon beside the regular game menu, or press [b]F8[/b].
On a controller, open the regular game menu and press the [b]right stick[/b].
The journal opens on Here Now each time. Going back returns you to the same game menu and tab.
[list]
[*][b]Mouse:[/b] click fish and buttons; use the wheel to scroll. Right-click filters to cycle backward.[/*]
[*][b]Keyboard:[/b] arrow keys to navigate, Enter to select, Tab to switch pages, Page Up/Down to scroll and Escape to go back.[/*]
[*][b]Controller:[/b] stick or D-pad to navigate, A to select, B to go back and shoulder buttons to switch pages.[/*]
[/list]Generic Mod Config Menu lets you change or disable the F8 shortcut and choose the default discovery setting.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Reads the game’s loaded fish, location and item data, including changes from other mods. It does not change fishing behaviour, catches, inventory or collection records.
Custom fishing systems and complex conditions cannot always be predicted. Uncertain entries are marked conditional or accompanied by an incomplete-guide notice. Some special fishing locations, including mine fishing, may have incomplete lists.
In multiplayer, each farmer sees their own discoveries. Players can use the mod independently.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/b].
Extract the [b]SimpleFishdex[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch through SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

[b]Uninstalling[/b]
Remove the [b]SimpleFishdex[/b] folder from Mods. No save cleanup is needed.
